label: <DEL> step of long (L>=8) sequences whose first token is l
explanation: Fires almost exclusively (95% of mass) at the delimiter step, and only for long sequences (L=9: 77% of mass, L=8: 23%, L=7 trace, never L<=6). Magnitude is dominated by the first original token (= the token about to be output): first_tok l gives 79% of mass and nearly all top activations (~4-5); with L>=8 and first_tok l it fires 93% of the time. Other first tokens (2, x, o, 3 ...) give weak delimiter activations (mostly <0.25 of max) at L=8/9, which are the bulk of missed steps by count. A small weak secondary activation appears on the last original token (step before <DEL>) of L=9 sequences, about 5% of mass. Never fires in the copy phase or for short sequences.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the first original token (most: l, 2, x, o, 3, z; least: f, j, e, u) and the second original token (most: l, i, 3, x, r, h; least: t, e, u, j); timing cues that raise it most: t=8, L=9 & t=9, L=9 & t=8.
